title: security/__init__ docstring: used real PARSER_POLICIES registry name
body: Rewrote src/umd/security/__init__.py module docstring for the delivered Plan C security boundary. Initial draft named the policies registry 'ParserProfileRegistry'; verified against policies.py that the real symbol is the module-level PARSER_POLICIES dict of ParserProfile (with policy_for/registered_workloads helpers). Corrected the docstring bullet to reference PARSER_POLICIES. Kept honest capability-gating note for bubblewrap/AppArmor.

title: Plan C round-2 gap fixes applied (5 files)
body: Fixed all 6 gaps from DocsAnalyzer. G1 policies.py: removed non-existent 'model' key from module docstring; noted model is HTTP-only (no sandboxed dispatch); reworded past-future inline comment above audio profile. G2 README: retitled to "(phases 1–3 delivered)", rewrote intro to name delivered Plan C scope, added 3-phase scope bullets under renamed "## Delivered scope", demoted foundation list to "### Foundation authority (roadmap Phases 1–3)". G3 README: added pysubs2 1.9.0 to pinned dep list (kept SQLAlchemy 2.0.x). G4 webvtt.py docstring: corrected "returns (text_unchanged, None)" → always-returns-transformation-dict (never None, strips header, keeps WEBVTT magic, applied=False path); fixed garbled "(negative (non-negative clamped))". G5 evidence.py: "map it" → "maps it". G6 .env.example: added worker-side sandbox section listing gate-relevant vars (UMD_DIARIZATION_*_GATE, UMD_VLLM_ENABLED, UMD_SCENE_ENGINE_PYSCENEDETECT, UMD_VIDEO_DECODE_PYAV, etc.); qualified pydantic-settings-only header claim. ruff + py_compile clean. No UNNECESSARY/PARTIAL this round.

title: Semantic analysis docs added to providers.md; /capabilities has no semantic key
body:
Added semantic text-analysis provider section + capability bullet + provider-table row to docs/providers.md for Plan M. Verified env vars UMD_SEMANTIC__PROVIDER/UMD_SEMANTIC__MODEL (config.py:131-143, double-underscore), SemanticTextAnalyzer (semantic_analyzer.py), strict parser (semantic_parser.py), SemanticAnalysisResult categories (semantic.py; StateObservation uses observed_state), deterministic baseline (text_structural.py), and STRUCTURAL_ANALYSIS composition (production.py _structural_analysis).

NOTE: /v1/capabilities (api/routers/system.py:131-151) does NOT currently expose a semantic-analysis key — the semantic capability bullet is written as posture disclosure (reference active by default; provider path configured-only) rather than a reported /capabilities field. If a future plan adds semantic to capability_report(), the providers.md capability bullet should be updated to reference the reported status.
